title: QUIC: Support multipath extension decryption
description:
Store whether the client and server have negotiated multipath.
Store the sequence number for each connection ID, and copy it
when looking up connection IDs from various methods.
Use it to adjust the Packet Protection as described in 5.2
of the current QUIC multipath draft.

The separate number spaces are not supported yet, which means
some issues, especially with fragmentation.

Related to #19314

notes.body: We can also conclude that if we see an ACK_MP frame (on CID seq number 0) then multipath has been negotiated.
